x: Len Orton, our second claim member from Birchfield, was prominent and Robin Weate was also well placed. Eric Gebbett seemed to be taking an easy start but at the next appearance had worked his way through the field.

Our first(?) man home was Len Orton, our second claim member from Birchfield, who recorded 4m.30.2s. Mal Ash collected his usual quota of points with a win in the High Jump (5'7") and a second in the pole vault(11'6").
The mile proved to be an interesting race between Shipley and Len Orton, both second claim members, who finished first and second respectively in 4m.29s. and 4m.33s.
Charlie Jones won both sprints in 10.2 and 23.0 and also the high jump with 5'2". Len Orton was well beaten by J. Heywood of Herne Hill in the 3 miles, Len's time being 15m4s.

We must thank our second claim member, Len Orton, for his support at our fixtures. I understand that he will be returning to his first claim club Birchfield very soon and I feel sure that he carries our best wishes for his future, both in his athletics and his career.
